annotations.title: See the orders of a number

description: Lists the orders of the workspace’s WhatsApp numbers, newest first, one page at a time, with how many orders each order desk tab holds. Each belongs to one number and one customer, and has its order number, status, payment status and method, lines (product, quantity, price and where the price came from), delivery fee, total, delivery address, courier and tracking number, the customer, the ad the chat came from, who it is assigned to, what is still missing, the fields marked Check, and risk notes from this workspace’s own orders. Read-only.

ad_id.description: Only orders whose chat came from this Click-to-WhatsApp ad, by its ad_ id.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

city.description: Only orders delivered to this city.

conversation_id.description: Only the orders of this chat.

from.description: Made on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

payment_status.description: unpaid, deposit_paid, paid, cod_collected or refunded.

status.description: draft, awaiting_customer, confirmed, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled, returned or problem.

to.description: Made on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

view.description: An order desk tab: needs_ok (drafts), awaiting_customer, to_ship, out_for_delivery, delivered, problems, or unconfirmed (no answer 20 hours after it was sent).

name: list_orders
title: See the orders of a number
